# Features

Every feature of Protobase, grouped by area, with whether it is stable.

Every feature of Protobase is listed on the page of its area, one line per feature: its name and what it gives you. A linked name leads to the page that explains it in full.

A feature without a mark is stable. The others say so after their name:

- **beta**: built, released and usable, with the limits its page lists. It may change more than a stable feature.
- **in development**: partly released, not usable on its own yet.
- **coming soon**: documented, not built yet.

## Areas

- [Start a project](features/start-a-project.md): Start a new app, or an admin over an existing Postgres database, and keep the config in step with it.
- [Data model](features/data-model.md): Describe the tables of an existing Postgres database as resources, with their fields, keys and rules.
- [Access](features/access.md): Decide who may read and change which records and fields.
- [Lists](features/lists.md): The list page of each resource, with its columns, filters, charts, search, exports and imports.
- [List displays](features/list-displays.md): Show a list as cards, a map, a board, a calendar or a timeline, and reorder records by hand.
- [Record pages](features/record-pages.md): The page of one record, with its sections, related records, galleries, charts and editing.
- [Actions](features/actions.md): Buttons that change records, ask for input or run your own code, per role.
- [Composed pages](features/composed-pages.md): Pages of your own, built from blocks in a JSX layout.
- [Your own code](features/your-own-code.md): React components, field types, pages and handlers of your own, loaded as plugins.
- [Look and language](features/look-and-language.md): The app's colours, name, icon, language and installation.
- [Navigation](features/navigation.md): The sidebar, the user menu, the bottom bar on phones and the global search.
- [REST API](features/rest-api.md): The API every resource gets, with filters, writes, errors and the typed client.
- [API functions](features/api-functions.md): Endpoints of your own beside the REST API.
- [Sign-in and accounts](features/sign-in-and-accounts.md): Sign-in methods, users, roles, organizations and tokens.
- [Files and images](features/files-and-images.md): Uploaded files and images, where they are kept and how they are served.
- [History, comments and live updates](features/history-comments-and-live-updates.md): The changes of each record, comments on it, and pages that refresh as records change.
- [Events, webhooks and jobs](features/events-webhooks-and-jobs.md): React to changes, deliver them to other systems, and run work in the background.
- [Email and public forms](features/email-and-public-forms.md): Mail the app sends, and forms for people without an account.
- [AI](features/ai.md): Fields and actions filled by a model, the assistant beside the admin, and MCP.
- [Compatibility and moving from other systems](features/compatibility.md): Apps written for other systems that keep working on Protobase, and moving their data and code over.
- [Several apps](features/several-apps.md): Show another Protobase app's records and accept its users.
- [Build and run](features/build-and-run.md): Develop, build and run an app, on servers, in containers and on phones.
- [Releases](features/releases.md): How Protobase is released and versioned, and what a release keeps working.
